bug_hunt.title: Both managers tap at the same second and the slower one sees an error
bug_hunt.plain: Hits Career Start, the Transfer Challenge locks and timer, and Setup confirm. Nothing is corrupted, but the loser must tap again.

bug_hunt.title: A tied season is decided by league position
bug_hunt.plain: Code and old notes disagree on equal non-zero scores.
bug_hunt.note: Nik chose league position; docs fixed in PR #343 (merged)

bug_hunt.title: Nobody cross-checks the two managers' season results
bug_hunt.plain: Both can publish position 1 or both tick Champions League. Nik chose (2026-10-04) to warn, not block: the commit screen now shows a CHECK RESULTS line on a clash and committing stays allowed (PR #346, merged into recovery dc78ed7). Live since r53.

bug_hunt.title: Lock buttons have no confirm
bug_hunt.plain: One stray tap on LOCK MY GUESSES or LOCK MY SIGNINGS locks an empty list for the season; the helpful error text is hidden behind a code. Lock buttons now ask "Lock N of 3?" when a form is partly filled (PR #345, merged into recovery 6974408). Live since r53.
bug_hunt.note: PR #345 adds the "Lock N of 3?" confirm; live since r53 (2026-10-04)

bug_hunt.title: The 4-hour private session ends long games
bug_hunt.plain: A 5 or 10 season game outlives one session, so both managers must open a fresh one. Needs one retest mid-season. Now job 31 (ten-season games).
bug_hunt.note: job 31, PR #350 (recovery fb0dd02): one-tap reconnect after expiry; live at the next release
